subject: Vendr transient snapshot & upload gating for CAIQ mapping
messages:
From: Bethany Clark <bethany@clearwave.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T14:12:00Z
Subject: Request: transient snapshot + upload window for Vendr CAIQ mapping

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this — Clearwave is finishing the CAIQ reconciliation for our joint audit and we need a short-lived snapshot of Redwood's Vendr profile and a few supporting artifacts to validate a handful of mapped controls. Specific asks:

- One 1hr upload window where we can POST 3 files (manifest, sample cert, and an example logs bundle).
- A small CSV manifest with filename + SHA256 hashes (we will validate integrity).
- Confirmation whether files will be uploaded to Vendr directly or to an S3 presigned URL you provide. If S3, we need the presign TTL and the expected bucket/key prefix.
- If you can provide a KMS-signed attestation (or PGP) of the manifest that would be ideal, otherwise a SHA256 signed by an account key is sufficient.

Timeline: we are hoping to ingest this on or before July 3 to keep our CAIQ run on schedule. Can you confirm feasibility and suggest an upload window?

Attachments: sample_manifest_schema.csv (schema only)

Thanks,
Bethany Clark
Senior Trust Engineer
Clearwave Security
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Clark <bethany@clearwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T17:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: transient snapshot + upload window for Vendr CAIQ mapping

Bethany —

Ack and thanks for the clear checklist. Short plan below; happy to adjust.

Summary plan
- Upload mechanism: we will provide a one-hour presigned S3 upload window (PUT) into a dedicated, short-lived bucket prefix (redwood/vendr/evidence/clearwave/).
- Pre-assign window: proposed July 2, 14:00–15:00 UTC (we can shift +/- 4 hours).
- File naming and manifest: please use the manifest CSV column order we attached (filename, size_bytes, sha256_hex). We will validate the manifest against actual objects on receipt.
- Integrity attestation: we will upload a KMS-signed envelope (AWS KMS Sign) as <manifest>.sig and also include redwood_sha256_manifest.csv. If you require PGP instead, state that and we'll provide an alternate.
- Retention & TTL: files will be available for 7 days from upload then auto-expire. Presign TTL will be 2 hours; upload window will be enforced by the prefix ACL and a short-lived IAM role.

Action items for you
- Confirm July 2 14:00–15:00 UTC or propose a different 1hr slot.
- Confirm whether you need PGP or KMS signature.

I attached a short instruction stub (instruction_v1.md) with the exact presign URL pattern and example curl. Laura — can you validate the key policy and confirm we can create the temporary role for s3:PutObject limited to the prefix? Karthik — raising because we may need to flip a Vendr integration toggle depending on whether Clearwave uploads to Vendr UI vs. S3 ingestion.

Attachments: instruction_v1.md

Best,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Security Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Bethany Clark <bethany@clearwave.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearwave S3 Uploads <s3-uploads@clearwave.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: transient snapshot + upload window for Vendr CAIQ mapping

Thanks Marcus — July 2 14:00–15:00 UTC works for us. Couple of clarifications before we lock in:

- We prefer KMS-signed manifest but can accept PGP as fallback. Please include the KMS key ID in the attestation metadata.
- The logs bundle will be ~120MB; please confirm the presign supports >5MB PUT requests (we assume yes).
- For the sample_cert.pem, will you accept our standard path name (clearwave_sample_cert.pem) or do you require your own naming convention?

Small ask: could Redwood also include a short JSON metadata file at upload (upload_metadata.json) that lists the Vendr profile ID and CAIQ mapping version used to generate the manifest? That will speed ingestion on our side.

I'll have S3-ops coordinate the upload client and provide any concurrency notes.

—Bethany
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Clark <bethany@clearwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T18:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: transient snapshot + upload window for Vendr CAIQ mapping

Bethany —

All set, confirming details and a couple final checks:

- Window: July 2, 14:00–15:00 UTC (one-hour). Presign TTL will be 2 hours starting 13:45 UTC to allow test PUTs; keys expire at 15:45 UTC.
- KMS: we will sign the manifest with AWS KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01; the signature file will be redwood_sha256_manifest.csv.sig. We will include the KMS KeyID in upload_metadata.json. If you need a PGP fingerprint we can add one, but KMS is preferred.
- File names accepted: manifest as redwood_sha256_manifest.csv, sample_cert.pem (or your clearwave_sample_cert.pem — we will accept either, please include actual filename in your manifest).
- Max object size: S3 presigns support >120MB; we'll surface a 256MB soft limit for the prefix to avoid timeouts on slow clients.
- upload_metadata.json: will be required and must include keys: vendr_profile_id, caiq_version, manifest_hash_sha256. We will provide a template in the presign email.

Laura: please confirm role creation and that the prefix ACL will be active by EOD (I flagged with infra). Karthik: if Clearwave prefers to upload to Vendr UI instead of S3, we will need the Vendr ingestion toggle enabled; can you confirm post-check?

Attachments (we will place these in the presign email): instruction_v1.md, redwood_sha256_manifest.csv (template), sample_cert.pem

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Marcus Lin
Vendor Security Lead
Redwood Inference
